counterexamples: Recording one key twice, or retrying after a commit whose acknowledgement was lost, leaves exactly one row.

tempting_allegations.allegation: Retrying the insert can write the same event twice.
tempting_allegations.evidence: database_writer.py statement text; tables.sql primary key.
tempting_allegations.why_wrong: The statement is INSERT OR IGNORE and idempotency_key is the primary key, so a repeated execution is a no-op.
